alt: Corrected quad-core shared conflict monitor architecture with four independent trace inputs and four one-way two-bit control outputs

text: Trace0..3 carry valid physical data access metadata into the shared monitor. CtrlState0..3 are independent one-way 2-bit outputs to each pipeline: 00 Ignore, 01 Halt, 10 Resume, 11 Reserved. A conflict occurs when simultaneous valid requests have the same physical address and at least one request is a write. This monitor is a proposed extension and remains separate from the coherence controller.
